title: Widget accepts completed plain speech without state mutations, failed-message duplication or replay
steps: Run the deterministic mocked model contract tests. No real model, audio, visitor replay or site writes.
expect: Valid empty-argument status tool followed by HTTP200 stop plain final returns speech and preserves brief, choices and server facts.
A bounded plain conversational stop answer before any tool returns speech only; malformed JSON, unsafe text, refusals, truncated output and invalid status tools still refuse without retry.
Signed-in structured output cannot open login; diagnostic metadata never includes raw keys, prompt, history, body, tool arguments or URLs.

Failed turns remove only their optimistic row; pending words are deduplicated and remain manual while microphone readiness preserves the model error. Playback failure cannot park an answered turn as unsent.
fence: Speech-only compatibility before any tool or after a fenced read-only status tool; bounded replies, no inferred state/actions and sanitized diagnostics.

tests: read-only status tool plain stop answer becomes speech only without changing brief, choices or actions
structured final answer after status tool keeps the signed-in action gate and existing choices
plain compatibility requires a completed safe reply; malformed/truncated/tool-loop answers still refuse
safe diagnostics distinguish provider, JSON, answer shape and bounded tool errors without raw keys or names
plain completed conversational replies become speech without changing brief, choices or actions
failed turns roll back only their optimistic row and stay manual through microphone readiness
